title: AttackGuard — transient detection, false-trigger protection
description:
Implement Source/DSP/AttackGuard as a real-time-safe pick-attack / transient detector with false-trigger protection (no allocations/locks/logging on the process path).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md section 8 (band-limited transient detection, false-trigger protection, controls)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h AttackGuard-related IDs from phase A if present (enabled, amount, sensitivity, frequency, decay, softNoteAssist, maxThresholdReduction, confirmationWindow)
- Source/DSP/DetectorEngine.* and PerformanceStateMachine.* public APIs for the L[n] / open-score surfaces this unit will later feed
- Existing Source/DSP/ header style (prepare/reset/process)

Implement AttackGuard.h/.cpp per spec §8:
- Band-limited high-pass (or emphasis) on the mono key/input path, then finite difference:
  d[n] = x_HP[n] - x_HP[n-1]
  T[n] = max(|d[n]|, alpha_t * T[n-1])  (alpha_t from decay control)
  O[n] = L[n] + G_t * clamp((T[n] - T0) / (T1 - T0), 0, 1)
  where G_t is scaled by amount/sensitivity/maxThresholdReduction and L[n] is the detector level (dB or linear consistently with DetectorEngine consumers).
- Temporarily lower effective opening threshold / raise open score for detected pick events; expose thresholdReductionDb (or equivalent delta applied toward T_open) and openAssistScore.
- False-trigger protection (§8.3): a valid attack requires BOTH transient evidence AND minimum body energy within a short confirmation window (confirmationWindow). Reject cable clicks, single-sample spikes, and digital discontinuities — do not assert validAttack on impulse-only energy without body.
- Controls / setters: enabled, amount, sensitivity, frequency emphasis, decay, soft-note assist, maximum threshold reduction, confirmation window.
- prepare(sampleRate)/reset(); process mono key (and/or current L) sample- or block-wise → validAttack flag, transient strength, threshold reduction, assisted open score. Realtime-safe fixed storage only.

Do NOT implement FundamentalEstimator, SustainAnalyzer, or FeedbackDetector. Do NOT edit PerformanceStateMachine, PluginProcessor, or CMakeLists.txt (d.4 owns integration). Do NOT write tests (d.5).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: AttackGuard implements band-limited transient envelope T[n] = max(|d[n]|, alpha_t * T[n-1]) with d[n] = x_HP[n] - x_HP[n-1]
AttackGuard computes open assist O[n] = L[n] + G_t * clamp((T[n]-T0)/(T1-T0), 0, 1) and exposes threshold-reduction / open-assist outputs
Valid attack requires transient evidence AND minimum body energy inside the confirmation window (false-trigger protection)
AttackGuard exposes setters for enabled, amount, sensitivity, frequency emphasis, decay, soft-note assist, max threshold reduction, and confirmation window
No heap allocation in the per-block process path
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: use plain C++20 + JUCE types already in the project
fixed-size delay/HP filter state owned by AttackGuard
accept mono key samples and detector L as process inputs
forbidden: full onset tracker / YIN / note tracking
